identity_note: The TNCA records are on the delivery tree files:fe1b5199... (doc/r40_v3/identity_amendment.json). It differs from files:80dd1a82... only in python/tnca/inductor.py and python/tnca/triton_backend/compiler.py. The inductor.py changes are applied by tnca.inductor.configure() or gated on the TNCA device type, and configure() is called only by the TNCA platform (archbench/platforms/tnca.py, archbench/generate.py); the CUDA path imports no tnca.inductor module (recorded per boundary record). The compiler.py change (code larger than the code store raised as OutOfResources) runs only inside the TNCA Triton backend's compile; Triton backend discovery imports that module on the CUDA path, but the active backend there is cuda. The GPU records on files:80dd1a82... therefore remain the GPU side.
